description: Converts a note voltage into the control voltage that selects the sequence number on Impromptu's PhraseSeq16, PhraseSeq32 and GateSeq64

inputs.text: The note that picks the sequence, counted upward from C4; unpatched the module reads C4

outputs.text: A voltage of 0V to 10V reached over C4 to D#5, which selects sequences 1 to 16 on Impromptu's PhraseSeq16
A voltage of 0V to 10V reached over C4 to G6, which selects sequences 1 to 32 on Impromptu's PhraseSeq32 or GateSeq64

inputs.0:
unipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
